resources.string: Archives imported with Sonora. Open one to see its songs, delete it from your phone or remove it from this list.
Remove from History forgets the import only: its songs stay on your phone and in your library.
This can’t be undone. Its folder and every file in it are deleted, its songs leave your library, playlists and favourites, and the playlist it recreated is deleted.
Sonora can only read the folder “%1$s”. To delete these files, choose that folder again and allow access.
That was a different folder. Choose “%1$s” to allow deleting.
